Instrument.name: Nikon Z9 Camera
Instrument.description:
The Nikon Z9 is a flagship mirrorless camera incorporating a 45.7-megapixel FX-format (35.9 x 23.9 mm) stacked BSI CMOS sensor paired with the high-speed EXPEED 7 image-processing engine. It has a completely electronic shutter design, achieving shutter speeds up to 1/32,000 second. The camera maintains a native ISO range of 64 to 25,600, expandable from ISO 32 to 102,400, ensuring high-fidelity imaging with professional-grade dynamic range.
This is a "multi-instance" and "multi-host" instrument, meaning not a specific instrument but rather a type or model of instrument that may be used many times across one or more missions and is not associated with any specific host. Each of these instruments are functionally identical, although they may have instance-specific calibration information.
